text:
ina: hitting a weird mismatch between py/js SDKs in json-mode + function calling. Schema says metadata: object | nullable, but validator flips between null and {} on retries.
carlos: any chance the auth retry path is serializing twice?
ina: logs show the response body sometimes 'metadata':'{}' (string) or metadata:null. Only happens when our retry wrapper kicks in during token refresh.
sam: that suggests two problems: runtime double-encode + sanitizer parity. If SDKs parse leniently then JS may succeed while py fails.
dev-bot: note: issue opened (#4012) and canary patch to auth-retry normalization scheduled.
carlos: short-term: add a sample-app post-parse normalizer to coerce null->{} for object schemas to reduce onboarding friction. long-term: fix runtime and add cross-sdk parity tests in devex CI.
sam: I'll add unit tests for js+py sanitizer behavior and a small starter-kit note about json-mode fragility during retries.
ina: repro and minimal patch linked in #4012, assigning to eng-runtime + devex. Thanks.
